Dental Implant vs Bridge: Which Option Is Better for Missing Teeth in Thane?
Losing a tooth doesn't just affect your smile—it can impact your chewing ability, speech, confidence, and even your jawbone over time. If you're considering replacing a missing tooth in Thane, two of the most common treatment options are dental implants and dental bridges.

While both treatments restore your smile, they work differently and each has its own advantages.

🦷 What Is a Dental Implant?
A dental implant is a titanium post that is surgically placed into the jawbone to replace the root of a missing tooth. After healing, a custom-made crown is attached to the implant, creating a tooth that looks and functions very much like a natural one.

Benefits of Dental Implants
✔ Replaces both the tooth and its root

 ✔ Preserves jawbone and facial structure

 ✔ Does not require trimming adjacent teeth

 ✔ Excellent chewing strength

 ✔ Natural appearance and feel

 ✔ Can last for decades with proper care

🦷 What Is a Dental Bridge?
A dental bridge replaces a missing tooth by anchoring an artificial tooth to the neighboring teeth.

To support the bridge, the adjacent healthy teeth are usually prepared and fitted with crowns.

Benefits of Dental Bridges
✔ Faster treatment completion

 ✔ Lower initial investment

 ✔ No surgical procedure required

 ✔ Fixed and comfortable solution
